styles.name: White bib apron, Mandarin Oriental bib size, concealed stud adjustable neck strap through a cloth loop, no pocket — Fat Duck cutlery and feathers logos
styles.desc: BIB APRON · Same size as the Mandarin Oriental bib apron · Self fabric waist ties and neck strap · Concealed stud fastened adjustable neck strap, 5 cm longer than the standard with an extra stud, fastened through a cloth loop at the back of the bib top · No pocket · No towel loop · Fat Duck spoon, knife and fork logo top left as worn and feathers logo bottom left as worn, in black
styles.lectra: AP0532, variant 0605 — the OHAP0605 stud marker for the neck strap studs
fabrics: White 100% organic cotton 260 gsm X149ECO AM05 (Tiajo) — rating 0.90 m; the lay plan's marker AP0605001 is 1.75 m for 2 (0.875 m)
trims: THREAD — WHITE PERMA CORE 75 20000 M CONE 32109W (Somac) — cost per metre (the sheet says Coats Epic 80 white; Sage holds white as the Perma Core)
Set 4 cm down from the finished top edge, to the right side seam as worn.
1 x male stud to the neck strap, set pre-make-up with the OHAP0605 stud marker. Sage's nickel ring press stud 032B/B (male fitting); the prong rings 032B/AR to match.
5 x female studs to the neck strap (the extra stud for the longer strap), set pre-make-up with the OHAP0605 stud marker. Sage's nickel ring press stud 032B/C (female fitting).
100% organic cotton · wash at 40° · low tumble dry · 2 dot iron · do not bleach · dry clean. Set 4 cm down from the top of the right side seam as worn, underneath the OH woven label.
mfg: Set the studs pre-make-up on the neck strap, using the OHAP0605 stud marker: 1 male stud plus 5 female studs.
Make the neck strap loop: fold in half lengthways, fold in the raw edges to neaten and edgestitch one edge.
Make the neck strap: bag out the end, edgestitch all round.
Set the bib top to the apron.
Double turn the armhole and topstitch 6 mm. Single turn the bib top to reduce bulk.

Set the loop and neck strap to the bib facing. The neck strap is set to the right side of the bib as worn, studs to the underside of the strap. The loop is set as high as possible to the fold of the bib top and inserted into the end of the left side of the bib top. Edgestitch the end of the bib and the top edge of the bib before stitching the loop down. The loop finishes 3 cm wide and fits the neck strap neatly.
Make the waist ties: bag out the ends, edgestitch all round.
Insert the waist ties. Double turn the side seams and hem to neaten and topstitch 12 mm. Insert the labels.
Fold the waist tie back onto the apron and edgestitch down onto the side seam.
Embroidery is set after make-up (taken off pre-make-up, JW 24/4/18).
fin: Trim, check and press. Thread the neck strap through the loop and fold the garment.
Tissue, bag and set the bag label.
styles.tol: Width ± 2 cm · Across bib ± 1 cm · Neck strap ± 1.5 cm · Length ± 2 cm
styles.brandPlace: Two logos in black, set after make-up. The Fat Duck spoon, knife and fork logo to the top left-hand corner as worn: top of the logo 1 cm below the bib facing and 1 cm in from the finished armhole edge. The feathers logo to the bottom corner, left side as worn, to finish 2.5 cm from the finished edge.
styles.note: Works order OHAP060501 for the Fat Duck (Oliver Harvey): the Mandarin Oriental bib size with a concealed stud neck strap (created as the dark navy version from SR526 3/11/16; extra female stud on the neck strap JH 9/1/16; neck strap 5 cm longer with the extra stud 27/2/17; embroidery taken off pre-make-up re JW's email 24/4/18; new routing card with the feathers logo jh 26/9/18; embroidery position changed re the Emb email JH 31/10/18; cloth amended from PC6001 to CO5001ECO re JW 10/9/25). The file name says a concealed pocket; the sheet says no pocket, and the sheet is followed. All Costings still carried the old PC6001 at 0.9 m: corrected to CO5001ECO in the app's usage table (FABRIC.md, Corrections to All Costings). The lay plan's marker AP0605001 (1.75 m for 2, 0.875 m) is the usage. The two logos and Luke's photo of the finished apron (15 Oct 2026) are on the record; the sheet's sketch is in works-orders/OHAP060501-FatDuck.xlsx.
